main_text.l: epist. 6. Voluntatis praeclarae ac studij iu-
lios cupiunt, eosdem laudare necesse ha-
ctiones, nō nisi ob res laude dignas insti-
te moneri sese grauiter molesteq; ferunt.
mur,in qua Planci contra hostes praeclare

page.notes: Left margin notes: "Materiae laudationum variae." (beside the sentence "Sunt autem res..."); "Imitatio laudationum epistolae." (beside "Nos exercitij... imitabimur", printed as "Imitatio lau- / dat.epistolae."). The second margin note is placed at its line in the text above; its exact wording is partly abbreviated and the hyphenation in the margin is hard to make out. Greek words in the first line and in "delatione" line ("<!-- Greek -->") could not be reliably reproduced and are left as placeholders for review. The printed "Imitatio" note is not included as a separate note because its wording is uncertain. Line "16.epist.16." may contain a printed abbreviation read uncertainly.
